estimate_focal_median: estimate camera focal length from 3D points using the median robust estimator method
estimate_focal_weiszfeld: estimate camera focal length from 3D points using the iterative Weiszfeld re-weighted least-squares algorithm
estimate_focal_with_bounds: estimate camera focal length with configurable min and max focal length clipping bounds
review_estimate_focal_knowing_depth: review the estimate_focal_knowing_depth function to understand its reprojection method for DUST3R output
summarize_estimate_focal_knowing_depth: summarize the estimate_focal_knowing_depth function which estimates camera focal from known absolute depth using median or Weiszfeld methods
